name: io.github.stefanbackor/edupage-keyring-mcp
title: EduPage Keyring
description: EduPage timetables, grades, homework and messages; session in macOS Keychain, no password.

packageArguments.name: --school
packageArguments.description: EduPage school subdomain (the part before .edupage.org). Repeat for more schools. Sign in first with `uvx edupage-keyring-mcp login <school>`.

environmentVariables.name: EDUPAGE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your EduPage login name (a label, not a secret). The password is never configured.
